priorityList: Maintain Windfury Weapon, Flametongue Weapon, and Lightning Shield at all times.
Apply and maintain Flame Shock on at least one target.
Use Ascendance if it will trigger an AoE Chain Lightning via Thorim's Invocation.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racial abilities during Ascendance or Doom Winds windows.
Cast Doom Winds on cooldown to maximize physical and Windfury damage.
Cast Tempest at 10 Maelstrom Weapon stacks, unless both Ascendance and Doom Winds are active simultaneously.
Cast Primordial Storm when at 10 Maelstrom Weapon stacks.
Cast Chain Lightning when you have 9 or more Maelstrom Weapon stacks.
Cast Crash Lightning to maintain its cleave buff or while Doom Winds or Ascendance are active.
Cast Windstrike as your primary filler while Ascendance is active.
Cast Stormstrike if you are about to cap charges or to reach maximum stacks of Converging Storms.
Cast Sundering on cooldown, especially if Feral Spirits are active.
Cast Voltaic Blaze whenever it becomes available.
Cast Lava Lash as a low-priority filler when other major abilities are on cooldown.
Cast Chain Lightning with 5 or more Maelstrom Weapon stacks if no other higher priority actions are available.
